brief.prompt: [brightly] Oh, hello! It’s me, Anne. I’ve just had the most wonderful drive of my whole life, eight miles with Mr. Cuthbert. [dreamy] The people here give such plain names to such beautiful places, so I gave them better ones. Will you build our drive with me, stop by stop, in the very same order? Then tell me my new names out loud. It would give me such a thrill.

video.script: Hi everyone. Today you’re taking an Imagination Trip into Chapter 2. Anne rides eight miles with Matthew, and she renames two places on the way. In VR you’ll build that drive as a road of four stops: the station, the horse and buggy, the apple blossoms and the pond. Then walk your road and say Anne’s names out loud. Then record a video, 30 seconds or less, where you say 2 sentences about one of Anne’s names, and submit it to Canvas. No headset? Pick Window Seat Day and do the same trip on your computer and record your 2 sentences in Canvas.
